items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1957-04-16
items.q: I got into Humberg and Rick Charles. Two cousins was fighting.

ctx.x: He hit him, too. I don't blame him. He's a pretty old girl. I wasn't that bad. I got into Humberg and Rick Charles. Two cousins was fighting. I called myself trying to separate them and they thought I was interfering, gonna get in and help them and they hauled off and they beat me half to death, both of them. I also I said, man, what are you doing? I said, I'm trying to separate you boys. I don't care who it is. I don't want to see you boys fighting.
I don't want to see you boys fighting.
